project: Medal of Honor: Vanguard — PS2 Static Recompilation
approach: Static recompilation of MIPS R5900 code to C++20, with a PS2Recomp-based runtime and Vanguard-specific overrides (faithful 59.94 NTSC clock on the wall clock, dedicated invocation stack, MKB mouse-look).
notes: Boots, plays the full EA logo movie with audio, stable post-movie (main alive past all former walls). The front-end/menu does not open yet: the game enters a post-movie circular idle decoded to instruction level (see docs/research-frontier.md). Mouse-look and scripted input implemented at the pad layer; menu interaction pending the front-end gate.
